name: warm-studio
_help: Six colours are enough; everything else is derived (see scripts/theme_util.py). primary = main accent, secondary = second accent, tertiary = contrasting accent, quaternary = deep shade used for text/shadows, dark = dark-scene base, light = light-scene base. Run `python3 scripts/analyze_video.py palette <video>` to get a draft sampled from the video itself.
